Unknown, unresolved, contradictory or unapproved expectations stay pending and preserve questions without invented expected results.

interface_handoff: The pure snapshot generator returns immutable normalized ready or pending acceptance records with stable identity, actual coordinates and traceable evidence.
P5-T5 consumes those records for Markdown/Gherkin and platform/mode tags. Pending records must retain questions and must not receive executable expected steps.
Generation itself performs no file writes, target implementation, acceptance-criteria checkoff, publication or host readiness promotion.
qualifications: The handoff limitation saying the final union has not run is stale preparation wording: the exact completed 123-node receipt and closure prove the final reversed union passed. The original handoff remains unchanged.
Exact base64 raw streams retain original bytes/newlines; readable views use the verified OBSERVED_PATH_ALIASES same-file roots and CR/LF normalization.
Current coverage includes six missing statements and six missing branch destinations; no full-coverage claim or raw counter augmentation is made.
Composition is pure in-memory generation; native publication, rendering and CLI/host proof are outside P5-T4.
historical_failures: The committed model/generation manifests retain original partial runs, fixture failures, counted-work defect, documentation repairs, and separate four-control coverage extension. Final acceptance does not rewrite them.
limitations: Six statements and six branch destinations remain uncovered as explicitly bound in the final raw coverage; all 35 measured ranges meet the required gate.
AC-49/AC-50 tags and Markdown/Gherkin rendering remain P5-T5 work.
Service/CLI, native publication, installed-host/cross-OS operation and whole-feature completion remain pending.
